signals.title: AI sector sentiment shift would compress your holdings, employer equity, and crypto simultaneously
signals.body: Matt Levine flags structural risks in the AI investment wave alongside Bitcoin margin loan securitization. The correlation risk here is that an AI sentiment reversal wouldn't hit just one position. It would propagate across your tech holdings, employer stock, and crypto at the same time.
sourceRef: Matt Levine: The AI Whateverpocalypse Trade

signals.title: Google is reshaping product strategy while AWS ramps $50B in competitive pressure
signals.body: Google is pushing AI integration across consumer products while Amazon doubles down on AWS infrastructure spending. The cloud competitive landscape is shifting, and the outcome will affect both your employer trajectory and your AMZN position in opposite directions.
sourceRef: App Economy Insights: Google The Genie is Out
